name: ScrollNarrative
description: Scroll-driven storytelling component that synchronizes narrative chapters and visual telemetry stages with progress-linked transitions and interactive scrubbing.
a11yNotes: Provides accessible chapter buttons and a progress scrubber so keyboard and reduced-motion users can navigate every narrative stage without mandatory scroll-jacking.

propsApi.name: chapters
propsApi.description: Ordered storytelling stages with title, copy, and metric.

propsApi.name: pinStage
propsApi.description: Whether the visual telemetry stage stays pinned alongside chapters.
